message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 65, "var": "size", "code": "if ((size & 3) == 0) {", "note": "Input of 324 bytes (81 uint32 code points) passes the size%4==0 gate, selecting the idn2_to_ascii_4i path where data is interpreted as a UCS-4 code point array.", "role": "source", "phase": "format"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 67, "var": "out2", "code": "char *out2 = (char *) malloc(64);", "note": "A 64-byte output buffer is allocated for idn2_to_ascii_4i, matching the documented 63-char+terminator contract.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 73, "var": "idn2_to_ascii_4i((uint32_t *) data, size / 4, out2, flags[it])", "code": "idn2_to_ascii_4i((uint32_t *) data, size / 4, out2, flags[it]);", "note": "Calls idn2_to_ascii_4i with 81 code points: two 40-char ASCII labels separated by a dot, whose combined ASCII output is 81 chars.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "lib/lookup.c", "function": "idn2_to_ascii_4i", "line": 611, "var": "rc", "code": "rc = idn2_lookup_u8 (input_u8, &output_u8, flags);", "note": "idn2_lookup_u8 converts the full domain (two labels + dot) to ASCII, producing an 81-char output string in output_u8, exceeding the 63-char single-label contract.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "lib/lookup.c", "function": "idn2_to_ascii_4i", "line": 621, "var": "output_u8", "code": "strcpy (output, (const char *) output_u8);", "note": "strcpy copies 82 bytes (81 chars + NUL) into the 64-byte out2 buffer, overflowing it. The output length is not restricted to 63 characters.", "role": "root", "captures": {"outlen": "(long)u8_strlen(output_u8)", "buflen": "(long)64"}, "condition": {"op": "gt", "left": "outlen", "right": "buflen"}},
  {"step": 6, "file": "lib/lookup.c", "function": "idn2_to_ascii_4i", "line": 623, "var": "output_u8", "code": "free(output_u8);", "note": "Heap buffer overflow already occurred at the strcpy; the 64-byte out2 buffer is overrun by 18 bytes, corrupting adjacent heap metadata.", "role": "sink"}
]
EOF
echo "written"; python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json')"` executed with exit code 0.
